checks.explanation: The Callin app launched publicly on September 2, 2021, as predicted.
China did engage diplomatically with the Taliban government, but large-scale rare-earth extraction infrastructure has not clearly materialized at the scale described.
Taiwan remains self-governed and outside PRC control as of 2026.
Chinese VIE-based ADRs have largely remained listed on US exchanges, with most companies reaching PCAOB audit compliance rather than being forced to delist.
VIE structures remain in active use for major Chinese tech companies; China has not moved to cancel them.
COVID-19 became endemic and persists in the population similarly to seasonal respiratory illnesses, confirming the prediction.
Starlink clearly became a major commercial success, but Tesla's humanoid robot (Optimus) remains in earlier-stage deployment rather than a fully mature, real product line.
No clear confirmation of the specific described deployment scale and use cases for Tesla's humanoid robots was found.
